name: Acceptance test 17 - over-broad GitHub Actions OIDC trust (role-trust, fail-closed by design)
note: IAM-707: role-trust family not yet modeled -> fail closed with UNSUPPORTED_POLICY_FAMILY. Encodes current design-blocked behavior; the follow-up feature must rate broad federated subject scope (repo:example-org/*) HIGH, recognize the aud check as a valid constraint, identify sub as broader than a repo+branch/environment binding, and not claim every repo can assume the role without matching token/workflow context.

designBlocked.followUp: queued as the immediate next feature (Oliver, 2026-08-22)
